about: The airport is 9 km south-west of Noyabrsk. Operator: JSC Surgut Airport. Runway 2,500 m, serves domestic flights within Russia.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: About 9 km to the city centre. City buses No. 7 and No. 51 (Vyngapurovsky settlement) run. Taxis are available.

terminals.title: Terminal
terminals.text: The terminal is open from 07:00 to 18:00. Domestic flights only. Inside: cafés, shops, souvenir kiosks, baggage wrapping, a mother and child room, left luggage.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Premium comfort lounge on Level 1, VIP lounge on Level 2. The lounge offers tea, coffee and pastries. For a fee according to the price list: food ordered from the café, transfer to the aircraft by separate vehicle. The premium comfort lounge is open daily.
